text.p: Bangladeshis will have a two-day weekend from Friday, an official announcement said on Thursday.
It said the government had decided that daily working hours from Sunday through Thursday would be extended by one hour from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Transaction hours in banks would be from 8:30 am to 5 p.m.
Factories, shops and private establishments would be free to fix their own working hours, the announcement said.

It said the decision to implement a two-day weekend had been taken in view of the "problem of officials and employees in performing their family and social activities". The new working schedule would raise efficiency, productivity and mobility in offices, it said. Bangladesh's business community recently demanded that the current Friday weekend should be changed to Saturday or Sunday to conform with the international weekend, following the recent lead of neighbouring Pakistan.

They said Bangladesh faced serious difficulties in overseas business because of its Friday weekend. But orthodox Islamists both within and outside the government, and some opposition political parties, strongly opposed the idea.
